name: Fractal Brownian Motion (FBM) Terrain Density
definition: Generates terrain density by summing multiple octaves of simplex noise with varying frequency, amplitude, and weight, modified by a base surface plane, terracing, and bedrock layers.
summary: Fractal Brownian Motion Terrain Density generates 3D volumetric terrain by summing modified simplex noise octaves to create sharp mountain peaks, differing from standard texture generation by modeling solid geometry.
